rv.q: This wonderfully immersive musical remains an inspiring and timely story of hope, resilience and resourcefulness

Guided by scraps of knowledge and a sympathetic librarian, he begins to imagine a windmill that could generate electricity and save his community from famine. It is a compelling premise, and Richy Hughes’ book and lyrics ensure that the stakes are always clear.

cn.t: This RSC musical about Malawian teen William Kamkwamba's inspiring response to the 2001 famine earns praise as an uplifting, well-crafted production that delivers a powerful and hopeful story.

dr.inst: Released @ 10 AM via TodayTix app only. Until 18 July 2026.
